verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair axis for a CRM, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk data export feature, open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), or an offboarding path. The only related item is general access to RESTful APIs, a developer building block from which an export could be constructed, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
